questions.prompt: How many games did the 2002 Kings win at ARCO Arena?
questions.note: 36 home victories in a deafening arena.

funFacts.text: The Kings suffered only five home losses during the season.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Sacramento Kings | 61 | 21 | .744 | – | 36–5

funFacts.text: Their away record was 25–16, substantially less dominant.
Sacramento enjoyed a twelve-game winning streak around the new year.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: posted a 12-game winning streak between December and January

questions.prompt: Willis Reed limped out for Game 7 of the 1970 Finals. How many minutes did he play?
questions.note: 27. He did not leave after his first two baskets, despite the legend.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Contrary to popular lore, he did not sit out after his first two baskets, but remained on the floor for 27 minutes

funFacts.text: Reed's entrance was so improbable because a torn thigh muscle had kept him out of the previous game.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Due to a severe thigh injury suffered in Game 5, a torn muscle that kept him out of Game 6

funFacts.text: He made New York's opening two baskets on his first two attempts, electrifying Madison Square Garden.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: he scored the Knicks' first two field goals on his first two shot attempts

funFacts.text: On defense, the injured Reed held Wilt Chamberlain to two makes on nine attempts while he was guarding him.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: limiting him to two shots made in nine attempts

questions.prompt: How many points did the 76ers score in their overtime Game 1 win over the Lakers in 2001?
questions.context: 2001 NBA Finals · June 6 · Philadelphia at Los Angeles
questions.note: 107, the Lakers' only defeat during that postseason.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: June 6 @ L.A. Lakers W 107–101 (OT)

funFacts.text: That opening-game overtime win was the Lakers' only loss across their entire 2001 playoff run.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: By the end of the series, the 2000–01 Lakers held the record for the best postseason record with 15–1.

funFacts.text: Philadelphia outscored Los Angeles 13–7 in overtime after a close regulation contest.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Scoring by quarter: 22–23, 34–27, 23–27, 15–17, Overtime: 13–7

funFacts.text: The Sixers had just survived two straight seven-game playoff series against Toronto and Milwaukee before reaching the Finals.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: had just come out of two straight seven-game series against the Toronto Raptors and Milwaukee Bucks
